title: Intraparticle entanglement-based Random Access Code protocols: Contextuality-enabled quantum advantage and implications
summary: We provide the first explicit identification and quantitative characterization of the physical origin of the quantum advantage in the Random Access Code (RAC) protocol. This is achieved by formulating the protocol in terms of intraparticle entanglement between co-measurable degrees of freedom of a single particle and establishing a fundamental correspondence between the protocol's success probability and the underlying resource powering it.
